metaTitle: Hyde Park Veterinary Clinic: Vet in Hyde Park
metaDescription: Hyde Park Veterinary Clinic at 1111 W Swann Ave is open weekdays 7:30am to 6:00pm and Saturday until noon. After hours, the site points you to Blue Pearl.

publish.hoursNote: Regular hours from hydeparkvet.com. The site also lists holiday closures and says to contact Blue Pearl after hours.

facts: Hyde Park Veterinary Clinic, Hyde Park, Tampa. Address 1111 West Swann Ave, Tampa, FL, 33606. Phone and text (813) 259-9698. Fax (813) 448-1288. Website https://www.hydeparkvet.com/.
The site says it is a neighborhood veterinary clinic in Old Hyde Park, and that clients can book an appointment and order food and medicine. It names the PetOne Veterinary App.
Main hours: Mon 7:30am - 6:00pm, Tue 7:30am - 6:00pm, Wed 7:30am - 6:00pm, Thu 7:30am - 6:00pm, Fri 7:30am - 6:00pm, Sat 8:30am - 12:00pm, Sun Closed.
After hours, the site says to contact Blue Pearl at their nearest location. Holiday hours printed on the page: 11/26/26 Closed, 12/25/26 Closed, 01/01/27 Closed.
The homepage does not print a procedure price list.

Nearby from our coordinates: Capital One Café 0.25 miles at 700 S Village Cir Ste 150, slug capital-one-cafe. CMX CinéBistro at Hyde Park Village 0.3 miles at 1609 W Swann Ave, slug cmx-cinebistro-hyde-park. Forbici Modern Italian 0.33 miles at 1633 W Snow Ave, slug forbici. Neighborhood /neighborhoods/hyde-park.

faq.q: What are the regular clinic hours?
faq.a: Monday through Friday 7:30am to 6:00pm, Saturday 8:30am to 12:00pm, Sunday closed. Call or text (813) 259-9698.

faq.q: Where does the clinic send after-hours emergencies?
faq.a: The site says to contact Blue Pearl at the nearest location. It does not name a street address for that hospital.

faq.q: Which holidays does the page mark closed?
faq.a: 11/26/26, 12/25/26, and 01/01/27. Confirm those dates on hydeparkvet.com before you go.
